Abstract.AbstractText: We thank Adami and colleagues for their interest in our study. We were prompted to conduct this study because of the strikingly positive results observed in the TNF-transgenic mouse model of RA in the repair of established bone erosions with the combination of an anti-TNF agent and parathyroid hormone (PTH), as compared with an anti-TNF agent alone.(1) This study demonstrated that the bone formation achieved with PTH was additive to the anti-resorptive effects of the anti-TNF agent. Thus, PTH might have the potential to repair erosions in patients with RA whose inflammation is well controlled by an anti-TNF agent. This article is protected by copyright. All rights reserved.
